name: kalshi-crypto-candles
notes: Structural gates over one `candles` pull of source kalshi-crypto-candles (1-minute, 15-minute series). Prices are dollars in [0, 1], so a value outside it is a unit slip. A minute with no trade has null prices, which in_range skips by design. Run: python -m dskit.onboarding validate --suite configs/suite-kalshi-crypto-candles.json --snapshot <snapshot-vid> --root <store root>.

rules.notes: An empty pull means no settled market in range or a wrong series list.
Every candle belongs to a market; the reader keys on (ticker, ts).
A contract pays 1 dollar; a price outside [0, 1] is a unit slip upstream.
The pack drops candles still forming at the capture instant; one dated after acquisition is a defect.
